undirected_cayley_graph.note: The undirected Cayley graph of a finite group gT and any S : {set gT}: vertices the group elements, x and y adjacent iff x != y and x^-1 * y or y^-1 * x lies in S; loopless also when 1 \in S, symmetric for every S, the usual Cayley graph when S is inverse-closed; no generation, abelianity or order condition. Not the directed Digraph cayley.
